G1_unambiguity.justification: The definitions of configuration states, tension, relaxed states, bottlenecks, and the sequential tie-breaking order are precise and support only one reasonable interpretation.

G2_completeness.justification: The rewritten statement includes the necessary bounds, input format, vertex numbering, guarantee of a solution, output format, and tie-breaking rule.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For a triple, exactly 12 assignments have tension 2 if and only if all three pairs are edges, so the rewritten condition selects exactly the same lexicographically smallest triangle as the original.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the elaborate configuration-and-tension construction feels somewhat contrived for expressing a triangle in a conflict graph.
